events.sql:
SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count
FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f
JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.headings AS h ON f.file_id = h.file_id
WHERE h.heading LIKE '%tent%'
ORDER BY f.line_count ASC
LIMIT 1;
